chunks: It is narrated in a report from al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
that he said: Yusuf entered prison when he was twelve years old, and he remained in it for eighteen years, and he lived for eighty years after his release. That is one hundred and ten years.

key_terms.السِّجْن: prison, referring to the imprisonment mentioned in Surah Yusuf
key_terms.يُوسُف: Prophet Yusuf (Joseph), son of Prophet Ya'qub (Jacob)

ai.seo_question: How long did Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) live according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) provides a chronological account of Prophet Yusuf's (Joseph) life, detailing that he entered prison at age twelve, remained imprisoned for eighteen years, and lived eighty years after his release, totaling one hundred and ten years. This narration provides a Shia scholarly tradition about the lifespan of this Quranic prophet, whose story is extensively told in Surah Yusuf (Chapter 12).

en.bilal-muhammad: It is reported that al-Sadiq (as) said:
Yusuf entered prison when he was twelve years old, and he remained in it for eighteen years, and he remained for eighty years after leaving it. That is one hundred and ten years.
